scope: First native arsenal expansion, build-defining item powers, native enemy affinities, two boss vulnerability counters and five expedition oath counters.

weapons.hammer: A damaging native hit creates three staggered terrain-projected fault nodes. Each secondary enemy is hit once across the line; primary target excluded. One-second recovery, line-of-sight and static-ground checks, actor limits, friendly NPC/watchman exclusions.
weapons.boomerang: Accepted native stun marks for four seconds; next damaging arrow or slingshot seed consumes it for +75% damage.
weapons.hookshot: Accepted native stun tethers for four seconds, movement -25%; next damaging hammer or bomb consumes tether for +75% damage.
weapons.bomb_and_bombchu: Damaging hit applies two seconds of 40% slower movement.
weapons.deku_nut: Accepted native stun applies 1.5 seconds of 40% slower movement.

native_family_affinities.semantics: Multipliers compose with native damage tables; zero native damage and hard shields remain protected. Arsenal status effects currently target these three families.

bosses.Gohma: Existing stunned, exposed-eye branch: hammer damage doubles; arrows/slingshot chip for one damage. Closed eye and unstunned damage phase remain protected. Native hammer already worked before this change.
bosses.King_Dodongo: Existing vulnerable branch after a bomb opening: native hammer damage doubles. Armored walking/rolling protection remains. Native hammer already worked before this change.

expedition_oaths.Iron: Swords x0.65; hammers, ranged and explosives x1.5.
expedition_oaths.protection: Ritual/relay shields gate damage and setup effects before multipliers.

Furnace_rhythm.effect: Sword technique primes a six-second basic weapon follow-up that reduces sword cooldowns by one second, once.

Moonwell_weave.effect: Three basic weapon hits within six seconds prepare a free Flame Burst, Frost Nova, Chain Lightning or Meteor. Native magic acquisition and idle meter required. Failed casts preserve charge; successful casts consume once.

Briar_reprisal.effect: Guardian technique opens a six-second guard. Actual health loss arms a six-second basic weapon counter that heals that loss, capped at half a heart, with ten-second recharge.

item_powers.invariants: Runtime-only; duplicate powers do not stack. Equipment/socket changes clear preparations and retain reprisal recharge. Pauses freeze timers. No new saved fields or RNG calls.

ui.layout: Dedicated Arsenal page with seven initially collapsed sections and Back to More/Escape navigation. Item powers remain inside unique, set and runework details. Free spell readiness appears in hotbar/journal cost.
manual_inspection: Final production build displays ARSENAL heading and all seven collapsed rows without clipping at 1708x1010.
Hammer disclosure opens cleanly and Escape returns to More.
A dedicated QA preview exercised moving world effects; captured frames did not provide a clear view of every new visual state. Do not treat this as complete effect/terrain visual acceptance.

incomplete_full_skill_runs.acceptance: Incomplete; process exited before final result. Cause not established. No test failure reported; not counted as passed.
Incomplete; process exited before final result. Cause not established. No test failure reported; not counted as passed.

validation.production_build: cmake --build build-cmake --target soh -j 6, successful; SOH_ARPG_RUNTIME_TESTS=OFF, SOH_ARPG_JOURNAL_TESTS=OFF. nm confirms arsenal implementation and absence of arsenal/skills test harnesses.

save.testing: Separate temporary SHIP_HOME directories and debug/practice adventures; no normal-save writes.

limitations: This pass extends native tools; it does not add separate rolled bow/hammer/boomerang loot slots.
New status/affinity support is limited to Stalfos, Wolfos and Lizalfos/Dinolfos; original boss additions cover Gohma and King Dodongo.
Boss QA calls actual native phase functions in the relevant boss rooms, but does not complete full unassisted boss fights.
Broader normal-play acceptance across both ages, dynamic/steep terrain, regions, long runs and crowded scenes remains.
Full all-rune native regression did not finish; only completed focused 40-check skill-cost suite is counted.
Broad replayability goal remains active and incomplete.
